request.request: Write the paragraph from the officer's details in document 1.

response_text: {"paragraph":"Dance Marathon is a long dance event where students come together to raise awareness for children's hospitals. It is for the students who join in as dancers and spend many hours on their feet for a cause they care about. We are reaching out because we would love to have smoothies for our dancers. A refreshing drink would matter to the students who come, because it would help them keep going and feel looked after while they dance. Your help would be a real part of making the event welcoming for them, and we would be glad to tell you more about how the day works.","contains_instructions":false}
